- Initial release of yaps-text-to-speech: convert text to spoken audio using Yaps with selectable voice and language support.
- Supports Kokoro (English), Chatterbox (Expressive English on Apple Silicon), and Supertonic (supported languages).
- Ensures audio files are complete, playable, and accurately represent the input text.
- Voice cloning available only when a suitable, authorized reference is provided and supported.
- Respects existing voice settings and does not affect other installed engines.
- Users must install Yaps (2.3.124+) and sign in before use.
